title: 七五三の和風フレーム
subject_en: Decorative frames/borders with an EMPTY centre filled with plain white so it becomes transparent; each frame is ONE separate piece centred in its cell, landscape or square, thick enough to hold text or a photo. Japanese traditional style, flat colours. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 七五三向けの飾り枠素材6点です。写真台紙、SNS画像、おたよりに写真や文字を重ねて使えます。
items: a frame decorated with red and white long stick candies in bags, centre empty
a frame with two white cranes and gold clouds at the corners, centre empty
a frame of pine, bamboo and plum blossom branches, centre empty
a frame of chrysanthemums in red, gold and white, centre empty
a frame with colourful temari balls and ribbons at the corners, centre empty
a frame made of folded fans in red and gold overlapping along the border, centre empty
